public_adapters.f_1F58_0006: uint32_t BIOS logical TickCount from configured modulo-2^32 approximately 18.2Hz service
public_adapters.f_1F58_0017: ordered byte exchange copy using native pointer spans and uint16 count
public_adapters.f_1F58_0038: BIOS key availability word with pending-key path; clears NumLock through provider iff source g_53BD is nonzero
public_adapters.f_1F58_005A: BIOS blocking read or exact pending-key consumption path
public_adapters.f_1F58_0090: source two-read key normalization, including AH=8 only after two zero reads
public_adapters.f_1F58_00A1: explicit restore of the vector recorded by f_1F58_00B8
public_adapters.f_1F58_00B8: configured atomic install plus registered restore cleanup; fails closed without all services

provider_requirements: A key-availability service must return the actual BIOS-style AX key word or no-key status.
The blocking key service must produce a real key or report failure; it may not fabricate an empty key.
The time provider must use the existing source logical 18.2Hz clock (e.g. an adapter over SimTimingClock), not SDL event timestamps.
The NumLock provider and Ctrl-Break vector lifecycle are host obligations, not emulated DOS hardware in this module.

coverage: fixed 32-bit source ticks and missing-provider failure
byte exchange with disjoint buffers, zero count and overlapping buffers
pending-key slots, LIFO pushback order, availability without consuming and exhaustion
NumLock clear callback policy and count
ASCII-zero scan handling, sign-extended high-byte ASCII, two-read key path
Ctrl-Break install, registered cleanup, and explicit restore

limits: No SDL provider is bound in this component; root must adapt Host and existing SimTimingClock through PortableInputTimeServices.
DOS BIOS tick reads, physical BIOS key polling/NumLock, and hardware IVT/atexit behavior are not claimed equivalent; those leaf services remain configured platform boundaries.
Native pointer spans do not reproduce DOS far-pointer segment wrap.
